Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use a Holy Symbol or Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Craft

A room for preparing and storing sacred items and religious vestments.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Craft: Holy Water. The hireling crafts a flask of Holy Water in 7 days, at no cost. For every 100 GP you spend during its creation (maximum 500 GP), its damage increases by 1d8.

Craft: Magic Item (Relic). the facility's hireling can craft a Common or Uncommon magic item of your choice from the Relics tables of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The facility has the required tool, and the hireling is proficient with it and with Arcana; use the Crafting Magic Items rules for the time and cost. If the item lets its user cast spells, you must craft it yourself (the hireling can assist) and have those spells prepared every day you spend crafting.

Spell Refreshment. You regain one expended spell slot of level 5 or lower after spending an entire Short Rest in your Bastion. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a Long Rest.
